title: Concept: Podfile installs a pod from git
description: Podfile declares a pod sourced from a git remote, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The code is outside the spec repo's publication controls, so its checksum and version history are not covered.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Podfile (cocoapods).
risk: The code is outside the spec repo's publication controls, so its checksum and version history are not covered.
